name: xnurta-mcp
description: Amazon Sponsored Ads intelligence for AI agents: query advertising data, manage AI managed groups, create SP campaigns, and edit supported live ad entities.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze and manage Amazon Sponsored Ads with Xnurta.
interface.longDescription: Query Amazon Sponsored Ads performance, entity metadata, and operation logs; manage AI managed groups; create SP campaigns; and edit supported live campaign, keyword, target, and product-ad settings through Xnurta MCP.
defaultPrompt: Show my stores and summarize yesterday's ad performance.
Rank last week's campaigns by spend and include ACOS.
Create an AI managed group for these campaigns after showing me the full configuration.
Change this campaign's daily budget after showing me the current and new values.
Create a paused SP campaign for these ASINs after showing me the complete structure.
